createaddonorganizer.configuration.title: Create: Addon Organizer
createaddonorganizer.configuration.absor: Which addon tabs fold into Create, and where they land.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.force: Folded in even without a Create dependency.
Left alone, keeping their own spot in the tab bar.

createaddonorganizer.configuration.anima: Marks a banner as animated and sets its frame time in ticks.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.fetch: Checks once per launch. Banners you already have keep working either way.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.tinte: Keeps section titles readable on any banner.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.check: Checks Modrinth once per launch. Nothing downloads -- the notice just links to the mod page.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.twoTo: Primary colour on top, secondary along the bottom.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.showC: Fancy Tab Sections' collapse button on every banner. Off by default -- these banners aren't drawn for it.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.stick: Pins a section's banner at the top while you scroll its items.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.menuF: Frame cap for menus outside a world. Vanilla pins these to 60, making scrolling choppy; Max Framerate still wins.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.title: Default Title Text Shadow
Per-Section Title Text Shadow
createaddonorganizer.configuration.defau: How full a title must be before it scrolls. 1 waits for overflow; lower values scroll shorter titles too.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.textO: A section has no outline unless it's listed here.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.highl: Row colour for main tabs in the section list. Config screen only.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.secti: Anything unlisted goes on the end, alphabetically.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.index: Look of the section jump list.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.gridB: Closes the 1px gaps the item grid leaves above and below a banner, coloured to match the menu texture.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.edito: Set once you've clicked the banner preview. Turn it off to see the hint again.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.banne: Puts the banner preview under the title instead of above the buttons.
createaddonorganizer.banner.delete.title: Delete this banner?
createaddonorganizer.banner.delete.messa: This permanently removes the uploaded image %s. Any section still using it will fall back to a plain colour next time it's rebuilt.
createaddonorganizer.box.delete.title: Delete this box texture?

createaddonorganizer.tabs.title: Creative Tab Studio
createaddonorganizer.tabs.itemDisabler.t: Edit the list of items Item Obliterator removes. Only shown when Item Obliterator is installed.
createaddonorganizer.disabler.title: Item Disabler
createaddonorganizer.disabler.dropHint: Drag items here to disable them
createaddonorganizer.disabler.noConfig: No item_obliterator.json5 in your config folder yet — launch once with Item Obliterator installed.
createaddonorganizer.disabler.writeFaile: Could not write item_obliterator.json5. See the log.
createaddonorganizer.disabler.manual.too: e.g. minecraft:diamond, or !minecraft:.*_sword for a regex.
createaddonorganizer.disabler.restartNot: Item Obliterator reads this file at startup, so changes apply after a restart.
createaddonorganizer.tabs.full: No spare slots left — restart the game to add more
createaddonorganizer.tabs.emptyTab: Click items on the right to add them.
createaddonorganizer.tabs.name: Tab name
createaddonorganizer.tabs.group.tooltip: Ctrl+click an item, then ctrl+drag across its neighbours to select a run -- only squares touching the selection can join. Press Group to fold them into one slot; the first item you picked becomes the one you click to expand it. Right-click a grouped item to rename it, change its icon, or ungroup.
createaddonorganizer.tabs.tip.group: Ctrl+click items, then press Group to fold them into one slot.
createaddonorganizer.group.title: Item Group
createaddonorganizer.group.name: Group name
createaddonorganizer.group.icon.tooltip: Shown on the group's slot while it's closed.
createaddonorganizer.tabs.groups.tooltip: Every item group on this tab, and the import/export that shares them with Condensed Creative.
createaddonorganizer.groups.title: Item Groups
createaddonorganizer.groups.empty: No groups yet -- ctrl+drag over neighbouring items in the editor, then press Group
createaddonorganizer.groups.import.toolt: Reads Condensed Creative's condensed_entries files from loaded resource packs and folds matching items into groups. Entries a mod declares in code aren't in those files and can't be read this way.
createaddonorganizer.groups.import.none: No condensed_entries files in the loaded packs
createaddonorganizer.groups.import.noMat: Found %s entries, but none of their items are on this tab
createaddonorganizer.groups.export.toolt: Writes this tab's groups as a Condensed Creative entry file under config/createaddonorganizer/condensed_entries.
createaddonorganizer.groups.export.empty: Nothing to export -- this tab has no groups
createaddonorganizer.groups.export.faile: Could not write the export -- see the log
createaddonorganizer.groups.ccNote: Condensed Creative is installed; its own folding is kept off the tabs this mod lays out.
createaddonorganizer.sections.title: %s
createaddonorganizer.tabs.noWorld: No world loaded — a few items with custom renderers show as coloured tiles.
createaddonorganizer.tabs.delete.title: Delete this tab?
createaddonorganizer.tabs.delete.message: "%s" and all of its styling will be removed. This cannot be undone.
createaddonorganizer.tabs.reset.title: Reset this tab?
createaddonorganizer.tabs.reset.message: "%s" goes back to the order and contents its own mod ships. Your sections and removals for it are discarded.
createaddonorganizer.tabs.tip.bulk: Shift + Left click to bulk move items.
createaddonorganizer.tabs.tip.history: CTRL + Z and CTRL + Y to undo / redo.
createaddonorganizer.tabs.tip.banner: Click the pencil on a section to edit its banner.
createaddonorganizer.tabs.resetSection.t: Restores just the selected section to its original tab's contents. Everything else here is left alone.
createaddonorganizer.tabs.resetSection.e: That section's original tab has no items to restore
createaddonorganizer.arranger.title: Tab Arranger
createaddonorganizer.arranger.unsaved.me: You have unsaved tab order changes.
createaddonorganizer.arranger.hintPages: Drag a tab to any slot on any page. Hold near the top or bottom edge to scroll.
createaddonorganizer.arranger.hint: Drag a tab to move it. Drag past the left or right edge to change page.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.arran: Screen edits one page at a time, like the creative menu. Pages shows them all at once.
createaddonorganizer.colors.title: Section Banner Colors
createaddonorganizer.colors.hint: Ctrl+Click to rename, Drag to reorder, "Edit" to change colors, Shift + Click to delete.
createaddonorganizer.colors.hint2: Click to select, Double-click or "Edit..." to restyle, Drag to reorder, Ctrl+Click to rename, Shift+Click to delete.
createaddonorganizer.colors.panel.ofTab: Section of %s -- ordered in the tab creator
createaddonorganizer.colors.panel.tabCre: Opens the tab this section lives in. Items reorder there; the banner is the same one you edit here.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.class: One centred column, an Edit button per row, no search or sidebar.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.color: The classic layout has no sidebar, so this does nothing there.
createaddonorganizer.colors.simulatedUne: Create Simulated cannot be edited because it uses a different tab system. This may be changed in the future.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.devmo: Test switches. Only visible while dev mode is unlocked.
createaddonorganizer.settings.title: All Settings
createaddonorganizer.settings.slider.typ: Ctrl + click to type an exact value.
createaddonorganizer.settings.reset.tool: Put every setting shown on the right back to its default.
createaddonorganizer.settings.reset.mess: Every setting under "%s" goes back to its default. Anything saved by the in-game editors under that heading is lost.
createaddonorganizer.settings.update.too: Version %s is out on Modrinth. Click to open the mod page -- nothing installs itself.
createaddonorganizer.style.title: Menu Style
createaddonorganizer.style.hint: Changes how this mod's screens look. Nothing moves, nothing is removed.
createaddonorganizer.style.default_moder: The settings menu's flat cards, rectangular buttons and gold accent, used on every screen.
createaddonorganizer.style.create.desc: Flat dark panels with light outlines, styled after Create's config editor.
createaddonorganizer.style.essential.des: Flat grey cards with a blue accent, styled after the Essential mod's menus.
createaddonorganizer.style.accent.desc: Change the accent colour used by every button outline, highlight, rule and scrollbar.
createaddonorganizer.style.saturation.de: How vivid the accent colours are. 100% leaves the preset as authored; drag left toward grey or right to intensify.
On: the panorama shows through a dark tint. Off: a flat opaque slate, closer to Create's own config editor.
createaddonorganizer.colors.resetAll.mes: This resets every banner colour/image, box colour, text colour, section order, and tab placement (added/removed sections) back to default. This cannot be undone.
createaddonorganizer.colors.resetPack.to: Hand the sections this pack's script sets up back to the pack. Sections it never mentions keep your edits.
createaddonorganizer.colors.resetPack.me: This drops your own name, colour, banner and placement for every section this pack's script speaks for, so the pack's choices apply again. Sections the pack never mentions are left exactly as you have them.
createaddonorganizer.colors.resetPack.do: Pack sections reset to the pack's defaults
createaddonorganizer.colors.resetPack.no: Nothing to reset -- those sections already use the pack's defaults
createaddonorganizer.colors.presets.desc: Presets can save Tab order, Color / images, Names, and tab placement.
createaddonorganizer.colors.presets.name: Name this preset
createaddonorganizer.colors.presets.appl: This replaces your current banner, box, and text colours/images, section order and names, and tab placement, with the preset's. This cannot be undone.
createaddonorganizer.colors.presets.rain: Warning! this preset is commonly associated with lag bugs. although it should be fixed, you never know. BEWARE!!!
createaddonorganizer.colors.presets.save: Save Current Config to This Preset
createaddonorganizer.colors.presets.dele: This permanently deletes the preset "%s". This cannot be undone.
createaddonorganizer.integrations.title: Integrations
createaddonorganizer.integrations.descri: A list of Mods that have dedicated functions / compatibility
createaddonorganizer.integrations.fancyt: Required! Draws the section banners and rows inside the creative menu and in the mods own config menus.
createaddonorganizer.integrations.create: The mod this was made for! while not required, CAO offers Auto-Sorting for Create and any of its potential addons.
createaddonorganizer.integrations.kubejs: Offers general compatibility with kubejs items and creative tabs, and also allows you to drive everything CAO related through KubeJS Startup scripts.
createaddonorganizer.integrations.itemOb: General compatibility with Item Obliterator, and a new GUI made for adding / removing disabled items extremely easily! (Check page all the way to the right)
createaddonorganizer.integrations.conden: Offers controls for grouping items through Condensed Creative in the creative tab editor, and adds color-coded groups.
createaddonorganizer.integrations.simula: Compatibility with Simulated's Naitive tab system.
createaddonorganizer.bugreport.title: Bug Reporting
createaddonorganizer.bugreport.heading: Found a Bug / Issue? Here is how to report it:
createaddonorganizer.bugreport.log: Upload a screenshot (if possible) and your Minecraft log.
createaddonorganizer.bugreport.upload: You should upload it to https://mclo.gs and share the link.
createaddonorganizer.bugreport.account: You also have to have a GitHub account.

createaddonorganizer.bannerAssign.title: Assign Mod Banners
createaddonorganizer.bannerAssign.descri: Dev-only: curate which banners a mod's tab offers, even if it's not installed right now.
createaddonorganizer.bannerAssign.noMatc: No mods or tabs match that search
createaddonorganizer.bannerPool.title: Banner Pool — %s
createaddonorganizer.bannerPool.descript: Click a banner to allow/disallow it. Empty = players see the full unrestricted gallery.
createaddonorganizer.colors.deleteMain.m: This removes "%s" as a main section. Its own tab returns to standalone, and any sections folded into it move back to their default tab. This cannot be undone.
createaddonorganizer.colors.deleteMain.b: This is one of Create's own tabs. Deleting it stops anything from being folded into it -- its own tab returns to plain vanilla, and anything that would otherwise land here (nothing else routes elsewhere) stays standalone instead. Undo later via "Reset All", a preset, or "All Settings".

createaddonorganizer.configuration.menuE: The section list fading in when opened.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.title: Title Glint
The shine across the section list title.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.smoot: Eases scrolling instead of jumping a notch at a time.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.itemS: Items sliding into place while you drag.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.itemP: The little pop when an item lands.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.bin.t: The bin's lid, the items falling in and the thump.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.paneR: The split bar easing into place instead of snapping.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.contr: The hints at the top fading between each other. Off leaves one up; clicking still changes it.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.style: The fade when you switch menu styles.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.butto: Buttons easing their outline colour when hovered.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.sound: None of it affects the game.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.allSo: Turns every sound below off at once.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.allAn: Turns every animation below off at once.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.sfxSt: Clicky is sharp and high. Thocky is deeper and duller.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.picku: Sweeping extra items into your hand with shift+drag.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.gridS: A dragged item moving one slot.
The split bar snapping to a new column count.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.scrol: A tick per notch when scrolling or dragging a scrollbar.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.block: Undo with nothing left, or scrolling past a list's end (also needs Scroll Tick on).
createaddonorganizer.configuration.binHo: The lid opening as you drag something over the bin.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.binIt: Each item landing in the bin.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.binCl: The lid shutting once everything has landed.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.appea: Default look of banners, boxes and title text. Per-section changes live under Editor Data.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.banne: The coloured bar at the top of each section.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.box.t: The box behind section titles that keeps them readable.
Colour, shading, outline and shadow for section titles.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.creat: How organized tabs behave in the creative menu.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.perfo: Try these first if a menu feels slow.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.onlin: Community banners downloaded from the internet.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.saved: What the editors write down. Editing by hand works, but the editors are easier.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.extra: Tabs that other tabs are allowed to fold into. Add one with shift + "+" in the creative menu.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.rainb: Colours every banner by its position, red through violet, ignoring the colour lists.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.defau: Banner colour for sections you haven't coloured yourself.
Second colour for the default banner: hex|DIRECTION|STYLE. Empty means flat.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.showA: Shows the whole banner gallery instead of each tab's picks.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.defau: Box colour for sections you haven't set one on. Alpha controls how solid it is.
Title colour for sections you haven't coloured yourself.
Second colour for the default title: hex|DIRECTION. Empty means flat.
Second colour for that bottom colour: hex|DIRECTION. Empty means flat.
Where two-tone titles change colour, measured down the letter. 0 is all bottom, 1 all top.
Shadow colour for sections whose shadow you unlinked from the title colour.
Colour the Outline panel opens on. Sections have no outline until you give them one.
Second colour for the default outline: hex|DIRECTION. Empty means flat.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.menuS: Look of this mod's screens. Default is vanilla widgets; Create and Essential copy those mods' own config editors.
Create style only. Lets the panorama show through instead of a flat background.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.menuA: Create style only. Hue for outlines, text and scrollbars. 205 is Create's blue, 280 purple, 120 green, -1 grey.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.cache: Caches item icons instead of rebuilding their models every frame. Much faster with big grids. Turn off if an icon looks wrong.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.extra: Your own uploads, added to a tab's banner picks.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.textS: For shadows unlinked from the title colour.
createaddonorganizer.colors.native.relea: "%s" handed back to the mod that draws it
createaddonorganizer.configuration.textB: No entry means it follows the global toggle.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.nativ: Sections whose look was copied from the mod that drew it. Remove an ID to copy it in again.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.slide: One menu leaves the way you're heading; the next arrives from behind it.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.swoos: How long the menu you are leaving takes to slide away, in milliseconds.
Time of the menu holding before going onto the next page, in milliseconds.
How long the arriving menu takes to settle, in milliseconds.
How far a menu slides, in GUI pixels, so it scales with your GUI scale.
Fades the menu out as it leaves. Off slides it without fading.
How the leaving menu picks up speed.
How the arriving menu settles. Overshoot and spring carry it past its resting place and back.
The left arrow, to All Settings.
The right arrow, to the Creative Tab Studio.
Opening a section's banner and colour editor.
The presets browser and its edit screens.
Tab Studio's own screens: the arranger, the tab editor and the tab picker.
Leaving a screen plays the same motion in reverse.
createaddonorganizer.slide.title: Menu Slide
createaddonorganizer.slide.hint: Drag a slider, then press Play to watch it.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.swoos: Fades the organizer menu in when you open it. Leaving never fades; it closes on the frame you press Done.
Which way screens reached without the arrows travel. Sideways makes them page like the arrows do.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.itemG: A small +/- on a group's slot, marking it as a group even when closed.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.banne: Logs one line the first time each banner is drawn: texture, frame count, colours. For chasing a banner that won't show.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.alway: Banners that keep animating unhovered. Format: textureId = true. Anything unlisted animates on hover only.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.openI: Set by clicking a group's slot in the creative menu.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.nativ: Which version of the copy above was made. Lower it by hand to redo every copied-in section.
createaddonorganizer.configuration.menuA: Default style only. Accent saturation as a percentage. 100 is as authored, 0 greyscale, 200 double.
Create style only. Accent saturation as a percentage. 100 is as authored, 0 greyscale, 200 double.
Essential style only. Accent saturation as a percentage. Starts higher than Create's, since Essential's blue is far more vivid.
Default (Modern) style only. How vivid the gold accent is, as a percentage.
